reports.rendered_content: Projective pano rendering shader supports primary-only and dual-projector fallback modes: primary sample is always computed; secondary sample activates only when `projectedUseSecondary==1` AND a valid projection exists. Visibility blending uses continuous scores (no hard 0.5 threshold), weighted by visibility, texel quality, and optional dominance boost (1.15) for modes 2 and 3. Winner-takes-most weighting (`power=4`) selects dominant projector while preserving narrow transitions near equal quality.
